title: All the Potions
description: its a Minecraft mod for Neoforge, this mod takes current minecraft effects that should be potions and makes them well into potions such as Haste which was the reason i made this mod it was going to be a datapack for a haste potion and ended up a modformore
body: The All the Potions Mod is well you guessed it a potion mod, this one in particual is in neoforge beacuse personally its my favorite, the mod takes current effects outside of potions and makes them potions so for example haste is now a potion (for those who mine) and so is hero of the village is now a potion (for them traders coming out of wallstreet) heres a full list of potions: Haste, Hero of the Village, Absorption, Blindness, Dolphins Grace, Glowing, Bad Luck, Mining Fatigue (for those who pull pranks), Saturaiton (or how i like to call it porkchop in a bottle), Wither, Levitation, Heath Boost, Hunger, Nausea, Conduit Power (dont know why you would want this but its there if you need it), and last but not least resistance. believe it or not this started out a datapack for a the haste potion and somehow made its way to becomeing a fully fleaged mod, And your probably not thinking this to your self but what about recipes how do i obtain these potions well the same way you would with any other potion you brew it or if your in creative just go into the potions tab and scroll till you see one you want or you can use a command via the text or via a command block and just use it how you normally would get a item with the /give command but back to crafting or brewing i should say you can use the ingame recipe search up thingy that minecraft has, This was a solo project by: Thudr (aka me), im a beginner modder or atleast i am when im typeing this, anyways hope you enjoy this mod pack and if you've read this long thank you.
